acceptance_criteria: A person other than the author installs the skill folder, configures their own hosts and usage source, boosts and turns down a multi-account estate through a real reset, and the dashboard plus readback match what their sessions actually ran. Source tests do not close this epic.
description: Public, generic version of a working private tool. Before a provider usage reset, turn every coding-agent account up (stronger model, more reasoning, fast mode or a named preset); once the reset lands, turn back down manually (done) or automatically from usage data. One lever with readback across launch configs and live Herdr/tmux/NTM sessions on several machines, plus an HTML dashboard that shows sessions that did not follow. The user decides when to boost; the agent proposes the command and runs it on instruction.
title: Reset Boost: one lever to turn a coding-agent fleet up for a usage reset and back down

acceptance_criteria: Provider-free tests pass on Python 3.10 (TOML tests skipped) and 3.11+; the cold exported-folder check drives boost, failed-usage hold, reset auto-down, cooling, idle, dashboard and event log; collection validation passes; the privacy review finds no estate identifiers.

description: Port boost/done/watch/status/dashboard, audit/set/presets, Codex/NTM transforms, live picker switching with footer readback, the SSH and Windows workers, the launch guard and the watch installer. Record unsupported layouts as regressions or documented limits.
